name: ai-schools-of-thought-explorer
notes: Static HTML content site (index, topic and school pages, news queue) on Vercel; matches the content-site preset except data. data=server because news.html is public and api/submit.js accepts any POST with no authentication and Access-Control-Allow-Origin *, and commits data/news-queue.json to main through the GitHub API with GH_TOKEN, so visitor-triggered state persists server-side. The content pages are read-only for visitors; the news curation write path is not. ai=none: the site is about AI but has no AI feature. stakes=daily-tool is the default. Deployed production URL https://ai-schools-of-thought-explorer.vercel.app (HTTP 200, verified); site checks run against it, walkthroughs against a local static server.
